source: Hobart 2040 Comprehensive Plan, Vision & Future Land Use chapter, Fig 11 (p.35) and Fig 12 (p.44); adopted Sept 6, 2023

properties.name: Former Drag Strip
properties.desc: Employment Center near the US 30 commercial area: light industrial, office and incubator space. Needs 78th Avenue and Underwood Drive.

properties.name: 61st Ave & Wisconsin St
properties.desc: Mixed-use commercial and residential hub serving St. Mary Medical Center visitors, staff and nearby neighborhoods. Depends on the Wisconsin Street extension.

properties.name: 37th Ave & Colonial Dr
properties.desc: Sanitary District land near Strack & Van Til and wetlands. Light industrial, commercial, or higher-density senior housing.

properties.name: I-65 & Ridge Road
properties.desc: Industrial. Several developable sites southwest of the interchange; the plan's stated obstacle is consolidating parcels held by different owners. Location approximate — the plan marks it with a circle, not a boundary.
